prompt_md: An amoeba lives one minute, then becomes 0, 1, 2 or 3 amoebas, each with chance 1 in 4. Every new one does the same. Chance the family started by one eventually dies out?
prompt_short: Amoeba becomes 0-3 amoebas each minute. Chance the line dies out?
hint_md: Each child starts its own family, which dies out with the same chance as the whole.
explain_intuition_md: Dying in the very first minute is only one way to die out: a family of two or three can still fade away later. Each child starts its own family with exactly the same chance of dying out, and that self-similarity gives an equation whose answer is about 41%.
